## Executive Summary

Total Recall is a Claude Code MCP plugin providing persistent memory across sessions. It combines a TypeScript MCP server (~780 lines), 6 bash hook scripts, a Node.js org vault sync script, and 2 skills. Built from a spec OCR'd from handwritten notes (Tickets.org PDF). 7 correctness/security bugs were found and fixed in a post-build code review.

architecture/flink-cdc-poc-docker-compos.author: adrianb
architecture/flink-cdc-poc-docker-compos.contentPreview:
## Executive Summary

Docker Compose stack for the 5-variant Flink MySQL CDC POC. Provides MySQL 8.0 with binlog enabled, Kafka in KRaft mode (no ZooKeeper), a Flink standalone cluster (JM + TM), and Kafka UI. All variants share this infra; server-ID ranges 5500–6099 are partitioned per variant to avoid MySQL replica ID collisions on restart.
